verdict.rationale: FireHydrant has an official MCP server, so an external AI agent can drive the product from natural-language requests, backed by an API documented as able to do anything the UI can. Its native AI features cover summaries, retro drafting and Copilot suggestions, not taking commands, and the Slack `/fh` interface is structured slash commands rather than natural language. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which MCP tools/actions are exposed, and hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation.
